scope: Known uniform physical-volume model, independent equal-N clouds, fixed M, h in [0,1/2]; q=R T squared only

decisions.coverage: Theorem: >=95pct for each fixed budget under the declared model; fresh observed rates are checks only
decisions.precision: Nonempty q interval, positive lower bound and exact radius <=1/5
decisions.planning: First passing power of four for 2epsilon sufficient-design rule, never a global minimum

failure_policy: Retain every abstention and failed control; no extra clouds, refitting or optional stopping
provenance: Mathematical development and off-grid identities precede this freeze. Target-grid calculation and all fresh clouds begin only after public source freeze.
